_comment: Optional human metadata for the live-deployments board.
Keys match either the Vercel project name or the repo name.
Entries with "pinned": true are shown even when no VERCEL_TOKEN is set,
which is how non-auto-discovered (or private-repo) builds stay listed.
Only live_url is ever rendered. Repo names are used for matching, never printed.

auvyren-virtual-store.title: AUVYREN
auvyren-virtual-store.description: Virtual storefront with a 3D garment rail, cart and an everyday edit, shipped as a fast static build.

samyog-portfolio.title: 3D Developer Portfolio
samyog-portfolio.description: Personal portfolio with 3D graphics, fluid motion and a project showcase, running on the Vercel edge.

note-app.title: NoteNest
note-app.description: Markdown notebook with instant local persistence, keyboard-first navigation and a distraction-free editor.

github-user-finder.title: GitHub Finder
github-user-finder.description: Search any GitHub handle and get a clean profile card with repos, followers and language breakdown.

result-card-generator.title: Result Announced
result-card-generator.description: Turns TU board marks into a printable, shareable result card with grades, GPA and percentage.

random-color-palette.title: Paletto
random-color-palette.description: Generates harmonious colour palettes, locks the swatches you like and copies hex codes in one tap.

password-generator.title: PassForge
password-generator.description: Cryptographically random password builder with entropy scoring, length presets and copy-to-clipboard.

country-info-app.title: Country Explorer
country-info-app.description: Search any country for capital, population, currency, languages and region data from a live REST API.
